body:
_Migrated from issue #1106, filed 2026-07-25._

Fixing the Fast Tests marker gap (#1105) makes 973 previously-deselected tests run — 937 under `tests/unit/`, 36 under `tests/smoke/`. 37 of them are red. They are quarantined in `tests/quarantine.py` so the gate can go green on the structural fix; this issue tracks emptying that file.

They fall into three root causes, none of which is "the marker fix broke something" — each has been broken for as long as it has been invisible.

## 1. `spec_from_file_location` shim rot — 30 tests, 4 files

`tests/unit/test_duplicate_index.py` (20), `test_duplicate_scan_queue_settings.py` (5), `test_duplicate_delete_index_maintenance.py` (3), `test_duplicate_scan_index_rewire.py` (2).

These load a `cps/*.py` module directly to avoid full Flask init, registering a stub `cps` in `sys.modules` and hand-stubbing the relative imports the module had at the time. The modules have since gained imports the stubs don't cover:

```
ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'cps.metadata_constants'; 'cps' is not a package
ImportError: cannot import name 'normalize_text_for_duplicates' from 'cps.duplicates' (unknown location)
```

The stub `cps` has no `__path__`, so any relative import without an explicit stub dies. **Not a product break** — the real imports work in the app; only the shim is stale.

Worth fixing once rather than six times: give the stub package a `__path__` pointing at the real `cps/` so unstubbed relative imports resolve, or move these onto a shared helper in `tests/conftest.py`. Whichever, the same rot will recur in any shim written the old way, so the shared helper is the better end state.

## 2. `tests/unit/test_oauth_session.py` — 4 tests that have never passed

`test_github_logged_in_aborts`, `test_google_logged_in_aborts`, `test_generic_logged_in_aborts`, `test_register_user_uses_manual_session` reach for `oauth_bb.github_logged_in` / `google_logged_in` / `generic_logged_in` as module attributes:

```
AttributeError: module 'cps.oauth_bb' has no attribute 'generic_logged_in'. Did you mean: 'generic_login'?
```

All three are nested inside `def init_oauth_blueprints()` (`cps/oauth_bb.py:922`) and are only ever bound as signal handlers via `@oauth_authorized.connect_via(...)`. They are not module attributes and never have been, so these four assertions cannot have passed at any point — they were written, never run, and never known to be wrong.

Testing them means either capturing the closures (call `init_oauth_blueprints()` with the blueprint list mocked and read the connected receivers) or lifting the handler bodies to module level so they're addressable. The second is the better product shape but is a real refactor of the OAuth login path — worth a design note before touching it.

## 3. `tests/smoke/test_iso_languages_locale_smoke.py` — 3 tests, possibly a real bug

`get_language_name` returns `"Unknown"` for the ISO 639-2/B code `ger` (German), and logs:

```
ERROR {cps.isoLanguages:79} Missing translation for language name: ger
```

Unlike the other two clusters this may be user-visible — a book catalogued with `ger` rather than `deu` would show its language as Unknown. Reproduced in the local venv, where compiled translations may be incomplete, so **confirm against a container built from `main` before deciding**: if `ger` resolves there, the tests need a translations fixture; if it doesn't, this is a real bug and wants its own issue and a fix, not a test change.

Start here — it's the only cluster with a plausible user on the other end.

## Done when

`tests/quarantine.py` is empty and deleted, and its guard test in `tests/unit/test_ci_test_lanes.py` is updated to assert the registry stays empty.
title: Triage the 37 tests that were red behind the CI marker gap
